verdict.rationale: The axis applies. The card ships a UI layer: AMD Software with HYPR-RX profiles, Anti-Lag and driver updates on a home tab. Nothing in the evidence shows those UI functions are exposed through an API. The ROCm/HIP compute libraries are developer building blocks for GPU workloads, not a parity API for the control software, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
